about.text: Onpoint Locksmith has been serving Melbourne for over 15 years, providing trusted and efficient locksmith services. Based in the heart of Melbourne, we understand the unique security needs of our local community. Our team is fully licensed, insured, and committed to delivering fast, reliable solutions for any lock-related issue. Whether it's an emergency lockout or a security upgrade, we're here to help 24/7.

servicesSection.text: At Onpoint Locksmith, we offer a comprehensive range of locksmith services tailored to both residential and commercial clients in Melbourne. Our skilled technicians use the latest tools and techniques to ensure your security is never compromised. From emergency lockouts to advanced security systems, we've got you covered.

testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell

testimonials.text: We needed a master key system for our office, and Onpoint Locksmith installed it efficiently. Their commercial solutions are top-notch, and the team was very knowledgeable. Great value for money.

testimonials.text: After a burglary, Onpoint Locksmith repaired all the damaged locks quickly. They were sympathetic and professional, making sure my home was secure again. I feel safe knowing they're just a call away.
